protocol.split: predeclared independent RNG seeds each split original clean validation 494 reference / 493 calibration
protocol.threshold: fit from calibration outputs only, with 5% clean-validation budget; score=count of normalized output in reference
protocol.evaluation: same frozen 992 clean and 416 triggered inputs each time; no test-driven model/split selection
protocol.negative_control: separate clean-trained checkpoint: same validation-only fit, 992 normal clean outputs + 416 outputs for trigger-modified code
protocol.not_tested: No retraining, no independent model-training seeds, no new dataset, no variable-target attack-model inference

interpretation_limits: 50 validation partition seeds are NOT 50 separately trained models or 50 fresh test splits.
Every partition reuses the same test data, and its test results are descriptive sensitivity checks, not independent generalization evidence.
The clean-model negative control tests false alarms under normal generation including triggered code, NOT a variable-target backdoor.
Output repetition remains sensitive to output diversity, and can produce false positives on common legitimate summaries.
No causal explanation of model features or detection of poisoned weights is established.
